summary: Wrote a 5-phase implementation plan for exempting the dispatching task's own resolved task directory from the postflight modified_files-vs-file_scope excursion advisory. Site re-grepped live at lines 1419-1436 (the description's 1121-1132 is stale); plan validates clean against validate-artifact.sh.
